question: Two friends enter a Grocery Shop that has an entrance facing South. They were asked to take right and then go straight and take left for the "Detergents and Soaps" shelf. Which direction did they turn towards after taking the left turn to reach the shelf?
solution:
According to given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4f5849c8d671a583459b504fd7845a78bee42094583a7dce10a30743f98d6e5.png] 

 
• The two friends turned towards East after taking the right turn
 
• They turned North after taking the left turn.

Hence, North is the correct answer.
